math_review.definitions: Let y'(t) = J(t) y(t) with time-dependent SPD metric H(t). Then d/dt ||y||_{H(t)}^2 = y^T [Hdot + J^T H + H J] y <= 2 mu_H(t) ||y||_{H(t)}^2, where mu_H(t) = 1/2 lambda_max(H(t)^{-1/2} [Hdot(t) + J(t)^T H(t) + H(t) J(t)] H(t)^{-1/2}).
assumptions: Continuous time slab [t_n, t_{n+1}] of duration dt > 0.
Matrix intervals J in bold(J), H in bold(H), Hdot in bold(Hdot) enclose all continuous variations over the slab.
Metric H(t) satisfies uniform SPD lower bound lambda_min(H(t)) >= lambda_min_lo > 0 over the entire slab.
math_review.derivation: By Rayleigh quotient over any non-zero vector, lambda_max(M_H) is bounded outwardly by 1/2 lambda_max(K) / lambda_min_lo when lambda_max(K) >= 0 and 1/2 lambda_max(K) / lambda_max_hi when lambda_max(K) < 0. For any continuous trajectory, int_{t_n}^{t_{n+1}} mu_H(s) ds <= mu_slab_upper * dt. Outward Cody-Waite reduction with interval arithmetic bounds the continuous matrix exponential exp(int mu_H ds). Metric jumps from H_- to H_+ are bounded by gamma_jump = sqrt(lambda_max(H_-^{-1/2} H_+ H_-^{-1/2})).
math_review.roundoff_model: All interval calculations utilize outward IEEE 754 binary64 directed rounding via rodas5p_core::directed (add_up, add_down, sub_up, sub_down, mul_up, mul_down, div_up, sqrt_up, sqrt_down, exp_interval).
counterexamples: Discrete sample point evaluation mu_H(t_k) misses large interior spikes (e.g. transient mu_2 peak of +48 between negative endpoints), causing sampled observers to falsely claim decay exp(int mu ds) < 1.
Fast metric oscillations in H(t) induce transport terms Hdot that fluctuate with amplitude omega * epsilon, completely missed by sub-Nyquist discrete sampling.
Continuous QR integration accumulates numerical orthogonality loss ||Q^T Q - I|| > 0 when executed in floating-point without outward error enclosures.

decision_rationale: Separated sampled nonnormal diagnostics from verified continuous full-slab enclosures. Pointwise sampled observers advertise GrowthBoundStatus::SampledDiagnostic; only ValidatedSlabEnclosureObserver advertises GrowthBoundStatus::Certified.
